C1222.title: “Price Discrimination Is Commercial Fraud!” SAMR Launches Investigation into Ctrip
C1222.summary: On January 15, 2026, the State Administration for Market Regulation initiated an investigation into Ctrip, stating that platforms must not use algorithms to engage in personalized pricing against consumers.
